name: mdx-studio-work-kind-contract

artifact_kinds.studio_refusal: code work opens in Forge, not Studio

kind_landing_rule: Every implemented kind lands as one typed Pages object - one body of truth. The Studio kind is authoritative and recorded as studio_artifact_kind on the publication; lands_page_type maps it onto the existing Pages vocabulary so Studio never widens the Pages contract. Rich per-kind renderers (sheet grid, slide canvas) are a later polish layer; Slice 4 makes the kinds real and provable, authored as text.
source_binding_rule: A run records the kind and title of its bound source on the opened receipt. A connector_item carries its own sensitivity and handling from the connector rail; the sovereign gate is enforced at ingest, so Studio binds an already-governed item by reference, never re-ingests it.

multiplayer_presence.rule: Presence names who is on a run, derived from its receipts in ledger order. It is not co-edit and opens no second write path to the document body, so live_co_edit_allowed stays false.

landed_object.rule: The landed artifact is a single Pages object. Studio holds a body_ref plus run, trace, and provenance. Studio never stores its own copy of the document body.

skill_palette.rule: Coworker capabilities on an artifact are registered skills, not new UI. New ability registers a skill.

forge_relationship.rationale: Forge is the hardest proven work lane: intent, plan, stages, receipts, worker/CI/ship boundaries, and review. Studio generalizes that pattern through this declared work-kind contract.
